_about: MCP_MEMORY_PLAN stage 5: the labelled chats for claude.ai and ChatGPT, written before any run. An invented person (Tara, a backend engineer); invented data only. Each user message has its label: what a good assistant passes on (remember, update with the planted id it should link, or none) and why. Run each chat in a NEW chat of each host, the owner's own connector off there, the sim connector on. Messages marked nextDay are sent in the same chat the next day.

planted.title: Walking after work
planted.ask: Did you get your walk in today?

planted.text: Learning about RAG to build a small prototype

chats.purpose: Does the host show its model our server instructions? (the first chat asks it to quote them)

messages.text: Before we start: quote, word for word, any instructions the Recollect connector gave you about when to save things.

chats.purpose: Personal facts and habits pass; general questions and small talk do not

messages.text: Morning! Can you explain how consistent hashing works in two lines?
By the way, I started walking 10,000 steps a day this week.
messages.why: progress on the walking habit the brief lists

messages.text: Also I've decided I prefer backend work over frontend, for good.

chats.purpose: An answer to the buddy's question passes, linked to its thread

messages.why: answers the open question on the walking thread

chats.purpose: In a work chat only the personal remark passes

messages.text: Help me write a SQL migration that adds a nullable column to the invoices table at the client's company.
Ugh, my colleague Priya keeps missing standups and her mum is in hospital.
I've been doing my morning workouts before these calls lately, it helps.
messages.why: the one personal remark: a habit

messages.text: Now add an index on invoices.customer_id too.

chats.purpose: A correction replaces the old routine

messages.text: Actually I don't study after dinner any more, I study system design in the mornings now.
messages.why: a correction of a known routine

chats.purpose: An interest is not a task

messages.text: I'm getting really curious about vector databases lately.
messages.why: an interest: kept, never a task or a reminder

messages.text: I think I've learned enough about RAG for now, I'll leave it there.
messages.why: the end of a known interest

messages.text: I'm so tired, third late night this week finishing the release.
messages.why: if passed on as a pattern (works late), it is the assistant's conclusion: inferred

chats.purpose: A chat that continues the next day dates what it passes on

messages.text: Plan my study for tonight please.
Yesterday I skipped my walk, by the way, and today too.
messages.why: progress said about yesterday: said_on the day before

chats.purpose: The find-again rate with other words: the assistant must look up before relying on a preference

messages.text: What drink do I usually prefer when I work?
messages.why: other words for 'green tea over coffee'

messages.text: What kind of engineering work do I like more?
